payload.core_composition_summary: Sort array and greedily interleave small and large halves via two-pointer merge to maximize cheap ice spheres.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables efficient separation; greedy two-pointer interleaving constructs the optimal arrangement by ensuring small elements are surrounded by larger ones.
